snippet.title: Second Chances | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Second Chances now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3407990/Second_Chances/ 

A turn based combat RPG, that tells the story of Paul Kimbel, a troubled author who seeks redemption and a way to return from the dead.
